selection_note: Eleventh complete five-source cohort after 50 screened sources, each new and included S1=A at the exact same frozen Index SHA, reviewed 2026-10-17. Prioritize native JavaScript/Python first-party claims, scoped scripts, evidence admission, persistent-quest metadata and deterministic checkpoint validation, not agent or provider runs. These rows record source-derived screening questions, not proven defects, admission, or permission for external publication. Script-only before/after; no LLM agents, simulated episodes, model providers, web actions, or benchmark runs. External forks and upstream PRs remain human-owned.

candidates.finding: Inspect the shipped first-party JavaScript scope/coordination claim admission for conflicting claims and stale ownership with finite synthetic claim records. Run only native scripts against authentic admission functions; never invoke a coding-model route, archon or fleet.

Screen bundled local dispatcher and writer-lease coordination logic for stale-lease, double-owner or invalid path admission using genuine first-party pure scripts and fixed state, without invoking Pi, agent personas, task work or external runtime.

Inspect first-party Python scientific evidence policy, linting and provenance schema boundaries for deterministic unsupported-payload admission using fixed in-memory data and native tests only; do not run scientific tasks, ADK agents, model critics or API providers.

Inspect first-party Node quest ownership and worker/session metadata persistence for race-safe admission or malformed state using only local deterministic script fixtures; never dispatch the commander, launch a worker, or invoke a model or machine agent.

Inspect first-party Python browser trajectory checkpoint and critical-resume input validation using fixed data structures only. No Playwright browser launch, live desktop interaction, Fara model agent, benchmark rollout, or hosted inference is permitted.
